units.source_text: 直到石头挪到足够一个人进出的缝隙时，发长彦突然听下吹奏，拍拍花斑狗的背，命令道：“阿咬，阿咬，咬死门口这个可恶的土蜘蛛吧。”

en.t: When the stone had shifted enough to leave a gap wide enough for one person to pass through, Kaminagahiko suddenly stopped playing his flute, patted the brindled dog on the back, and commanded, "Akou, Akou, bite that hateful earth-spider at the entrance to death."
